results.title: Vol 5 - Model deployment and change management
results.content: Deploying AI models securely requires strict version control, monitoring, and validation mechanisms to prevent unauthorized modifications. Effective version control is essential for managing AI models securely:. A financial services company might implement a change management process where model updates first go through automated security testing, then security team review, followed by business impact analysis, before receiving final approval for production deployment. Fine-tuning allows organizations to adapt AI models to specific business needs but also introduces new security risks, including data leakage and model drift. Defending against these sophisticated attacks requires multi-layered defenses, including regular model evaluations against adversarial inputs, frequent retraining from verified data sources, and analysis of model behavior across diverse test cases designed to trigger potential backdoors. Securing AI models requires a proactive, multi-layered approach that integrates strong deployment controls, fine-tuning safeguards, and real-time monitoring. * Google Secure AI Framework (SAIF) – Google’s security framework for protecting AI systems from adversarial attacks and model theft.
